legend.priority: 1 = do first, 5 = last; ties break by size (S before L)
legend.status: done | in_progress | ready | blocked | parked; ready/blocked are recomputed from depends_on by scripts/dag_next.py
legend.kind: infra (shared foundations) | product (a site or thing people use) | research | ops (operator clicks, minutes not days)
legend.size: S under half a day, M one to three days, L a week or GPU-bound
